project.description: PatchGuard (pg) — a standalone, annotation-driven code-hardening library. NT-motif name after Windows kernel PatchGuard (anti-tamper of kernel code): business code marks a class with @Guarded and the build applies bytecode hardening passes automatically, emitting a hardened jar with zero source pollution. Three artifacts with distinct lifecycles: - pg-api : the @Guarded annotation contract (Java 8, zero deps). The ONLY thing business modules import. - pg-engine : the transform engine — a HardenPass SPI + concrete passes (ASM), fail-safe (re-verifies output, keeps original on any failure). - pg-maven-plugin : a build-time Mojo that scans @Guarded, runs the engine, atomically replaces .class files in the output. Designed to be extractable into its own repository later: zero dependency on core/board, clean API boundary. A leaf in the reactor so every module can depend on pg-api and apply pg-maven-plugin.
